# Generated by the R-Type editor. Describes how to build this game project.
# This file is consumed as a subdirectory of the repository root with
# -DEDITOR_BUILD=ON so that Engine, Serialization and UI are already defined.

add_executable(Game main.cpp)

target_link_libraries(Game PRIVATE Engine Serialization UI)

if (CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Emscripten")
    set_target_properties(Game PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME index SUFFIX ".html")
    target_compile_options(Game PRIVATE -fexceptions)
    target_link_options(Game PRIVATE -sASYNCIFY -fexceptions --preload-file "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/.wasm_stage@/")
endif ()

if (NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Emscripten")
    add_custom_command(TARGET Game POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy $<TARGET_FILE:Game> "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Game"
    )
endif ()
